blocks.text: Alcare Place is a non-profit organization dedicated to the rehabilitation of addicted persons who have created a commitment to recovery. We’ve proven time and once more, since we opened our doors in February 1987, that it is attainable to rehabilitate addicted folks who are harmfully involved with alcohol, medication or gambling. Over the years, many individuals have entered our doors with a want to rebuild their lives and learn additional about awareness & prevention of dependence issues. After taking part in the Alcare Place Treatment Program, our clients come back to their communities as productive, contributing family members and citizens. Alcare Place provides a stable, safe and supportive atmosphere in that our program participants are able to focus their energies toward amendment and growth. Alcare Place can facilitate 13 clients and is supervised 24-hours a day. We are open to folks with dependence problems aged nineteen and over who are looking for a contemporary begin in life. As rehab from dependence is a multi-faceted, long-term method, solely those that show a commitment to recovery will be considered to attend our program. The common length of stay is five months, although it is not uncommon for clients to stay up to a year. Program participation and progress is monitored by usual case reviews.
